paragraphs.text: Savor the Flavor was a column that appeared weekly on DailyMTG.com . Written by members of the Magic: The Gathering Creative Team (mainly Matt Cavotta and Doug Beyer ), it explored the creative process behind the flavor, including card art, flavor text, card names, world-building, books, comics, and the foundations of Magic: the Gathering on fantasy. Until August 2008, it was called Taste the Magic . It was replaced in 2012 by the Uncharted Realms column. Although some of the articles of Savor the Flavor are story-based, most story articles fall under the Magic Story column.
